description: This file contains JavaScript code defining YUI-based widgets and components for SuiteCRM, including MessageBox, SelectionGrid, DragDropTable, AsyncPanel, ClosableTab, Tree, TVSlideIn/Out, and Record classes, with licensing and contact info in comments.

classes.name: sw.MessageBox
classes.description: Object for displaying message, prompt, alert, confirm, and progress dialogs using YUI SimpleDialog.

classes.name: sw.SelectionGrid
classes.description: Class extending YAHOO.widget.ScrollingDataTable for selection grid with multi-select and drag-and-drop features.

classes.name: sw.DragDropTable
classes.description: Class extending YAHOO.widget.ScrollingDataTable with drag-and-drop row reordering and grouping.

classes.name: sw.RowDD
classes.description: Class for handling drag-and-drop of table rows.

classes.name: sw.AsyncPanel
classes.description: Asynchronous content panel extending YAHOO.widget.Panel with loading and error handling.

classes.name: sw.ClosableTab
classes.description: Tab class with close functionality extending YAHOO.widget.Tab.

classes.name: sw.Tree
classes.description: Tree view component extending YAHOO.widget.TreeView with AJAX data loading.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVSlideIn
classes.description: Animation class for sliding in elements.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVSlideOut
classes.description: Animation class for sliding out elements.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Record
classes.description: Data record class with unique ID and data storage, overridden for reports.

methods.name: sw.MessageBox.show
methods.description: Displays a message, prompt, alert, or confirm dialog with configurable buttons.

methods.name: sw.MessageBox.updateProgress
methods.description: Updates progress bar in a progress dialog.

methods.name: sw.Template.exec
methods.description: Executes template string replacing placeholders with values.

methods.name: sw.SelectionGrid.getColumn
methods.description: Retrieves column object for a given column identifier.

methods.name: sw.DragDropTable._addTrEl
methods.description: Adds a table row element, with optional drag-and-drop setup.

methods.name: sw.Tree.sendTreeNodeDataRequest
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to load tree node data.
